The selected PR799 X4 program starts with 56 disjoint target-pair precondition triples. Their retained Horner implementation costs eleven primitives per real component; a four-operation, scratch-free factorization computes the identical pair map in both orientations. **Finite complex-supplier construction; no new kappa.**

| Complete local scalar program | Retained real primitives | Replacement | Saved |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Forward | 193,162 | 192,378 | 784 |
| Backward | 193,210 | 192,426 | 784 |

A short determinant/support proof establishes a four-operation minimum in the declared two-register alphabet (signed unit ADD, NEG, HALF, DOUBLE; no scratch/free swap). Independent exact BFS and all 11,111 words through length four agree. Separate optimal compilation of the original macros costs six, so fusion also saves **224 real primitives per orientation against that stronger gatewise baseline**. This is not a full-circuit optimum or measured runtime result.

Both complete scalar projections pass **737 formal columns** each, including arbitrary native helpers, eight dirty center cells and dirty coefficient work. All 672 deletion/sign mutants fail; seven additional interface/source tests pass. Exact whole-program prefix row-l1 maxima remain 525,312 / 5,338,828 and fractional guards remain 3 / 19. The isolated forward pair's prefix norm does rise 1 to 2, explicitly disclosed. Physical phase/frame/recursive precision is outside this scalar replay.

```sh
python3 -B research/x4-precondition-seed22/check.py
```

Expected: `PASS_X4_PRECONDITION_PACKAGE no_new_kappa`.

The package passes on macOS/CPython 3.14.7 with isolated optimized execution, and CPython 3.9.6 in a minimal relocated directory containing spaces. Independent AI-assisted proof/code review found no blocking issue. Selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks pass. One general `make verify` on an untouched base export completed six historical groups, then was deliberately interrupted after 10m53s during `verify-entrance-banks`; no complete-suite, selected cold-replay, global admission, hosted CI or Lean pass is claimed.

Only `research/x4-precondition-seed22/` is added: executable lowering, two exact certificates, proof, source pins, negative controls, local claim and validation. Base: `f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`; OS assignment seed **22**, complex-supplier track. The actual integrated X4 replay is consumed, not the historical 492-helper evidence copy. Main remained at the base during the immediate pre-submission refresh through #882; no pinned coordination issue exists. Newly arrived #882 changes individual historical JP8 coefficient macros, while this contribution changes complete selected-X4 two-register precondition blocks; #881 independently verifies U8. Neither implementation is consumed here. No selected frontier, generator, source archive or `upstream/` file changes.

Credit Jeremy Kothe's PR799, Chafik Boukhalfa's PR741, icekylinx's target-butterfly/emitter lineage, DreamingOfClouds, Rohan Arun, eumemic and retained predecessor notices. Sagar Thakrar's #750 studies historical CK scale relocation; Gareth Davidson's #837 lowers individual coefficients and #866 audits fractional grids. Their pinned implementations were checked for overlap; this contribution crosses the three macro boundaries of the selected X4 precondition pairs and claims no priority for elementary butterfly identities. No pending implementation is imported and savings are not assumed additive.

Prepared by **Philipp (@mightyOil)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate AI-assisted verification and review; not independent human peer review. Apache-2.0. All-size/compiler, realization, hosting, physical precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain inherited. The selected conditional kappa remains **0.001661634653669567**.
